اقتتلن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَتَلْنَ (iqtatalna) /iq.ta.tal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# اِقْتَتِلْنَ (iqtatilna) /iq.ta.til.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# اُقْتُتِلْنَ (uqtutilna) /uq.tu.til.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
